role: viral organ — one shared judgment per day, worldwide

laws.same_scroll_everywhere: same UTC date => same scroll for every player; index = int(sha256('WARREN_DAILY_V1:' + YYYY-MM-DD)[0:8 hex], 16) % bank_size; offline-verifiable
laws.verdict_not_purchasable: no ZOL, no item, no streak bonus may change or buy a verdict; stamps are free and final for the day
laws.consequence_cosmetic_first: consequences change how the warren LOOKS and BEHAVES today; never stats, never currency, never progression
laws.world_split_post_stamp_only: the % split is hidden until the player stamps — no anchoring
laws.no_guilt: missed day => scroll waits in fog at HOLD; streak counts stamped days and is NEVER reset by absence; no expiring rewards, no FOMO copy
laws.world_split_v1_honesty: offline v1 has no backend: split shown is hash-derived and labeled 'warren estimate (offline)'; real split is a reserved backend field, never faked as live data

share_artifact.format: 7-day emoji row (🌫 = fog day) + today's dilemma title + 'THE DAILY VERDICT'
share_artifact.example:
THE DAILY VERDICT — Gerald's Third Hat
🟢🔴🌫🟡🟢🟢🔴
stamped by the warren
share_artifact.one_tap: navigator.share with clipboard fallback; readable without login; contains no identifiers

selection.algorithm: sha256(salt + YYYY-MM-DD) -> first 8 hex chars -> uint32 -> % bank_size

bank.title: Gerald's Third Hat
bank.scroll: Gerald the bug formally requests a tiny hat. It would be his third hat, worn atop the other two.

consequences.TRY: Gerald parades all day in three stacked hats; goblins salute.
consequences.HOLD: The hat waits in the observation jar, admired hourly.
consequences.COMPOST: The hat becomes a mushroom cap; today all mushrooms look dapper.

bank.title: The Moon Ladder
bank.scroll: Zaz proposes a ladder to the moon, starting from the tallest mushroom. She has four rungs so far.

consequences.TRY: A four-rung ladder leans on the tallest mushroom; goblins wave at the moon from rung two.
consequences.HOLD: The blueprint is pinned to the Akashic Tree, fluttering importantly.
consequences.COMPOST: The rungs become a garden fence; the moon remains politely distant.

bank.title: Monument to the Pudding Bridge
bank.scroll: Erect a memorial statue honoring the fallen pudding bridge. Materials: pudding, naturally.

consequences.TRY: A wobbling pudding statue graces the village cross; it jiggles when anyone laughs.
consequences.HOLD: The statue idea rests under a cloth in the fog, wobbling gently.
consequences.COMPOST: The soil smells of berries all day; the stream giggles at the memory.

bank.title: The Silent Ringing
bank.scroll: Ring the signal bell today, but silently, out of respect for the sleeping bugs of the nursery.

consequences.TRY: Goblins mime enormous bell-ringing; everyone nods at the imaginary sound.
consequences.HOLD: The bell rope is wrapped in moss, pending further silence.
consequences.COMPOST: The bell's chime is composted; today signals arrive as gentle glitter.

bank.title: Gerald's Moat
bank.scroll: Rename the stream 'Gerald's Moat'. Gerald did not ask for this, which makes it more official.

consequences.TRY: A tiny sign by the stream reads GERALD'S MOAT; Gerald patrols it once, modestly.
consequences.HOLD: The sign lies face-down by the bank, awaiting cartographic review.
consequences.COMPOST: The stream keeps its name; the sign becomes a leaf-boat ramp.

bank.title: Mayor Fridge
bank.scroll: Elect the sunset fridge honorary mayor for exactly one day. It cannot speak, which helps.

consequences.TRY: The fridge wears a sash; goblins bring it small disputes it resolves by humming.
consequences.HOLD: The sash hangs on a branch, mayoral but unclaimed.
consequences.COMPOST: The election is composted; democracy smells of leftovers at sunset temperature.

bank.title: Backwards Day
bank.scroll: All goblins walk backwards today, to finally see where they have been.

consequences.TRY: Goblins walk backwards everywhere, colliding gently and apologizing forward.
consequences.HOLD: One goblin practices in place, moonwalking by the forge.
consequences.COMPOST: Walking stays forward; the idea fertilizes a very reflective mushroom.

bank.title: Lullabies for Glowcaps
bank.scroll: Sing lullabies to the glowcaps so they glow brighter. Or softer. Nobody has tested which.

consequences.TRY: Goblins hum at mushrooms all day; the glowcaps pulse along, possibly out of politeness.
consequences.HOLD: A songbook waits on the stump, open to page one.
consequences.COMPOST: The lullaby becomes soil; tonight the crickets sound suspiciously melodic.

bank.title: The Mood Rain Collection
bank.scroll: Collect today's rain in jars labeled by mood: pensive drizzle, gossip patter, dramatic downpour.

consequences.TRY: Labeled jars line the forge wall; goblins argue whether 3pm rain was pensive or smug.
consequences.HOLD: Empty jars wait with blank labels and enormous potential.
consequences.COMPOST: The rain waters the garden unlabeled, as rain insists.

bank.title: Postmaster Worm
bank.scroll: Appoint a worm as postmaster of the underroot. Delivery times: geological.

consequences.TRY: The worm wears a tiny cap; one letter is ceremonially delivered four inches.
consequences.HOLD: The cap waits on a pebble desk marked POSTMASTER.
consequences.COMPOST: The post office is composted; the worm continues its excellent existing work.

bank.title: The Leaf Regatta
bank.scroll: Race leaf boats down Gerald's Moat. The winner gets to name a cloud.

consequences.TRY: Leaf boats race all day; the winning goblin names a cloud 'Barnaby'.
consequences.HOLD: The fleet is moored at the stepping stones, sails furled.
consequences.COMPOST: The leaves join the soil; somewhere, a cloud remains unnamed and free.

bank.title: The Mushroom Choir
bank.scroll: Form a mushroom choir. Mushrooms cannot sing. Form it anyway.

consequences.TRY: Twelve mushrooms stand in choir formation; the silence is described as 'moving'.
consequences.HOLD: Choir robes (tiny) hang by the nursery, ready.
consequences.COMPOST: The choir disbands into soup stock; the soup hums.

bank.title: Midnight Picnic
bank.scroll: Hold a picnic at midnight under the Akashic Tree, so the Tree doesn't eat alone.

consequences.TRY: Blankets appear under the Tree at dusk; the Tree's leaves glow a shade warmer.
consequences.HOLD: A picnic basket waits by the roots, lid politely closed.
consequences.COMPOST: Crumbs feed the roots directly; efficiency is also love.

bank.title: The Complaint Exchange
bank.scroll: Trade one complaint for one cookie. The complaint must be sincere. So must the cookie.

consequences.TRY: A cookie stall opens; goblins queue with artisanal grievances.
consequences.HOLD: The cookie jar waits, lid ajar, accepting no complaints yet.
consequences.COMPOST: Complaints go straight to soil; the garden grows one sarcastic pepper.

bank.title: Name the Shadows
bank.scroll: Give every goblin's shadow its own name, for census purposes.

consequences.TRY: Shadows are formally named; Lulu's shadow is 'Uluh' and answers to nothing.
consequences.HOLD: The census ledger waits open at the S section.
consequences.COMPOST: Shadows stay anonymous; they seem taller for it.

bank.title: The Upside-Down Flower
bank.scroll: Plant one flower upside down to hear what the roots think of the view.

consequences.TRY: One flower is planted roots-up; it is either confused or avant-garde.
consequences.HOLD: The flower waits in its pot, right side up, suspicious.
consequences.COMPOST: Planted normally; the roots keep their opinions underground.

bank.title: Keeper of the Echo
bank.scroll: Assign a goblin to keep the canyon echo company. Echoes get lonely by the third repeat.

consequences.TRY: Nib takes the post and converses with himself at length; both enjoy it.
consequences.HOLD: A chair is placed at the echo point, reserved.
consequences.COMPOST: The echo keeps its own company, as echoes do, do, do.

bank.title: The Museum of Found Buttons
bank.scroll: Open a museum of found buttons. Admission: one button.

consequences.TRY: Four buttons are exhibited on moss plinths; visitors pay in buttons, doubling the collection.
consequences.HOLD: The plinths stand ready, buttonless and dignified.
consequences.COMPOST: The buttons return to the paths for future finders; the museum is everywhere now.

bank.title: The Fog Tax
bank.scroll: Tax the morning fog one wisp per visit. The fog has not been consulted.

consequences.TRY: A tiny tollbooth appears; the fog pays in wisps, which immediately evaporate.
consequences.HOLD: The tollbooth waits, barrier up, fiscally theoretical.
consequences.COMPOST: The fog roams untaxed; the treasury reports record humidity.

bank.title: The Grand Snail Prix
bank.scroll: Officiate a snail race. Estimated duration: the entire day. Possibly two.

consequences.TRY: Three snails race majestically; by dusk they have traveled a heroic arm-length.
consequences.HOLD: The starting line is chalked; the snails are napping in formation.
consequences.COMPOST: The race is composted; the snails win anyway, spiritually.

bank.title: The Night Ledger
bank.scroll: Let goblins deposit dreams in a night ledger, for morning withdrawal.

consequences.TRY: A velvet book appears by the nursery; morning readings are baffling and beloved.
consequences.HOLD: The book waits under a night-light, pages blank and patient.
consequences.COMPOST: Dreams stay in heads where they compost naturally into naps.

bank.title: Sir Twig
bank.scroll: Knight a goblin with a twig. The twig thereafter is also a knight.

consequences.TRY: Pip is knighted; the twig, Sir Twig, receives its own tiny scabbard.
consequences.HOLD: The twig rests on a cushion, pre-ceremonial.
consequences.COMPOST: The twig joins the soil with full honors; oak-hood posthumous.

bank.title: The Official Mirror
bank.scroll: Declare the big puddle an official mirror. Reflection quality: weather-dependent.

consequences.TRY: A frame of pebbles rings the puddle; goblins adjust hats in it solemnly.
consequences.HOLD: The pebble frame waits in a pile, reflective about its future.
consequences.COMPOST: The puddle stays a puddle; ducks approve the deregulation.

bank.title: Honey Diplomacy
bank.scroll: Send one jar of honey BACK to the bees, as a gesture of interspecies diplomacy.

consequences.TRY: The jar is left by the hive with a tiny flag; the bees file it under 'confusing but sweet'.
consequences.HOLD: The jar waits on the embassy stump, seals intact.
consequences.COMPOST: The honey sweetens the compost; the worms draft a thank-you note.

bank.title: The Star Census
bank.scroll: Count the stars tonight. Round to the nearest mushroom.

consequences.TRY: The official count is 'many, plus or minus a glowcap'; it is carved nowhere and remembered by all.
consequences.HOLD: The counting stick waits by the tree, notchless.
consequences.COMPOST: The stars go uncounted and therefore infinite; the mushrooms feel included.

bank.title: The Whisper Path
bank.scroll: Pave one path where everyone must whisper, so the moss can concentrate.

consequences.TRY: The east path gets a hush sign; goblins tiptoe past, whispering enormous greetings.
consequences.HOLD: The hush sign leans on a tree, clearing its throat quietly.
consequences.COMPOST: All paths stay loud; the moss adapts, as moss does.

bank.title: The Acorn Savings & Trust
bank.scroll: Open an acorn bank. Interest paid in oak leaves, eventually, by oaks.

consequences.TRY: A hollow stump becomes the vault; deposits immediately attract a squirrel auditor.
consequences.HOLD: The vault stump stands ready, echoing with potential.
consequences.COMPOST: The acorns are planted instead; the bank becomes a forest, long-term.

bank.title: The Lost Sock Oracle
bank.scroll: Consult the lost sock about the future. It has seen things.

consequences.TRY: The sock is enthroned on a pinecone; its prophecies are woolly but comforting.
consequences.HOLD: The sock rests folded, keeping its visions to itself.
consequences.COMPOST: The sock warms a seedling; the future arrives regardless, as scheduled.

bank.title: Gerald Appreciation Day
bank.scroll: Declare an official Gerald Appreciation Day. Gerald remains unaware, which is very Gerald.

consequences.TRY: Bunting goes up; goblins applaud whenever Gerald walks anywhere, which confuses him beautifully.
consequences.HOLD: The bunting waits in a basket, festive and coiled.
consequences.COMPOST: Appreciation continues informally forever, which Gerald would prefer anyway.

bank.title: The Tree's Birthday
bank.scroll: Throw the Akashic Tree a birthday. Age: unknown. Candles: as many as we have.

consequences.TRY: Candles ring the roots at dusk; the Tree glows back, which everyone agrees counts as blowing them out.
consequences.HOLD: The candles wait unlit in a spiral, patient as wax.
consequences.COMPOST: The candles are saved for winter; the Tree, being a tree, celebrates by continuing.
